scope: Manufactured exact contacts on all certified segments; not general Riemann states.
limits: Original normal velocities/pressures replaced by common contact values; density/tangent drawn from actual donor states.
Constant segment primitives; this does not integrate the previous fitted density or solve general jumps.
Exact contact only; no shock/rarefaction, full moment flux, force update, MPI or CUDA parity.
Common contact speed is not generally the geometric face speed; zero mass flux is tested only when wn=un.
